prompt:
Generate a high-fidelity desktop website homepage mockup for Thrun Design Co., strategic design studio for founders and business owners. Flat website screenshot, no device frame, no perspective, tall desktop page about 1440 wide by 2100 high showing five clear sections. User APPROVED palette: charcoal #171816, warm ivory #EBE7DF, near-black #0C0D0C, brass #D4AF6A reserved for buttons and small accents. NO cobalt, blue, green, orange or gradients. Preserve existing typography: Libre Baskerville regular serif display, IBM Plex Sans body, sparse IBM Plex Mono labels. Sharp corners, open layouts, no rounded cards. Preserve existing animated artwork, rendered here as a still of a fine ivory line horse-head engraving with flowing mane, labelled subtly 'Drag to explore'. Reference image is a palette study: use ONLY column 1 Charcoal & Ivory for palette; do NOT reproduce the comparison board or any headings of that board. Create ONE standalone website.

Content truth: Thrun Design Co.; navigation Services, Work, Process, Request a quote. Offer: Brand & system architecture; Web design & maintenance; Business marketing audits; Print & digital assets. Primary headline 'Strategic design when a rebrand, launch, or outdated site can’t wait.' Quote CTA near top and bottom. Portfolio examples Juniper & Stone coffee identity, Hollowbeam furniture identity, Living Engraving interactive horse, each clearly marked CONCEPT; use expressive coffee packaging specimen, restrained furniture brand specimen, and real-reference-inspired engraved horse. No invented clients, metrics, testimonials or awards. Body copy short and realistic, typography crisp. Separate sections dramatically with alternating full-width solid DARK, IVORY, DARK, IVORY, DARK. Vary scale and information density. Treat artwork as the feature, never substitute decorative waves. End on clear quote action and compact footer. LAYOUT 1 EDITORIAL SPLIT. Hero dark, 600px tall: oversized Thrun Design Co. aligned upper-left below restrained navigation, offer beneath, generous horse artwork occupying right half of hero, one brass CTA left. Services ivory, 400px: left one-third heading 'Four ways we steady a growing brand.'; right two-thirds four open horizontal numbered service rows. Work dark, 500px: one very large coffee identity image left and two stacked smaller concept images right, modest titles below. Process ivory, 330px: three open columns Discover & define, Design & build, Launch & handoff with large subtle numerals. Closing dark, 230px: huge left serif 'Where next?' and brass Request a quote button right. Strong asymmetric art direction, reading clarity, generous whitespace. This is a real multi-column desktop composition.
note: Static composition study; project artwork and copy are illustrative, use actual existing assets and CMS text in implementation.
